scope: Five compact Super Admin layout proposals
All-user professional profiles with Engineer and QA experience

super_admin_choices.status: Synthetic interactive previews; selecting/keeping is browser-local and does not apply a live layout
features: Actual hover/focus tooltips and accessible names

professional_profiles.schema: Two additive tables WorkProfile and ProfessionalExperience; authorization Profile unchanged
professional_profiles.publication: Private by default; owner-controlled publication; live shared-project/tenant/account checks on every read
professional_profiles.experience: Owned Engineer/QE CRUD; role, organization, dates, summary, self-reported qualifications
professional_profiles.client_visibility: Published Engineer/QE/TL/Admin staff on shared active projects; no Super/other Client discovery; no login/email/contact/password information
professional_profiles.audit: Publish state/experience IDs only; no profile body text

logo.source_copy: Byte identical to supplied image; no crop or generated alteration

validation.test_hashing: In-process synthetic MD5 override only; actual password hashes preserved
validation.data_preservation: Seven original business tables, existing account identities/password hashes/roles and 78 original photo SHA256 unchanged

browser_launch: Automatic approval review blocked opening browser; user can use local link.
